fact_text: The State Bank's minimum deposit ratio change lets banks lend to corporates as well as individuals at lower deposit-linked rates, which should cut deposit costs and widen spreads.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'HMB 10% Yield & HUBC 8% Yield | Bank Spreads Expand | Midday Flash 8 Jul 2026' (YouTube, 2026-07-08)

fact_text: Medium-sized banks gain most from lower deposit costs, because they pay higher deposit rates to attract funds, and the analyst named HMB, Bank Alfalah and Askari among the beneficiaries.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'HMB 10% Yield & HUBC 8% Yield | Bank Spreads Expand | Midday Flash 8 Jul 2026' (YouTube, 2026-07-08)

fact_text: The analyst called HMB and three other banks, including Bank Alfalah and Askari, strong in trade finance, where fees come from LCs, guarantees, demand drafts and cheque services.

fact_text: A consortium led by Bank of Punjab approved about 4.76 billion of 10-year Islamic syndicated financing for Airlink and its subsidiary Select Technologies; the currency was not stated.

fact_text: Pakistan has sourced phosphoric acid for DAP from Morocco under a partnership running since around 2000, and a Pak-Maroc unit operates in Morocco; the analyst sees Fauji Fertilizer as the main beneficiary.

fact_text: A 15 July 2026 deadline matters for brownfield refinery upgrades to meet Euro-5 standards, with a target investment of about $6 billion across Pakistan's four refineries, and relief may be granted.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'HMB 10% Yield & HUBC 8% Yield | Bank Spreads Expand | Midday Flash 8 Jul 2026' (YouTube, 2026-07-08)

fact_text: Refineries want to collect GST on supplies because they pay GST on imported components, which strains working capital, and no progress has been made on this yet.

fact_text: The analyst does not expect strong 30 June quarter results for refineries after windfall profits in the 31 March quarter, but pricing from July could improve their outlook.

fact_text: PSO's 30 June quarter results may be weak because of inventory losses, though conditions could improve from July, when the new fiscal year's physical cycle starts.

fact_text: Ex-refinery sale prices for petrol and high-speed diesel could rise back to about Rs 210 and Rs 216 per litre, the analyst said, which would help refinery pricing.

fact_text: Fuel prices that the government had brought down may rise again, which the analyst flagged as a red flag for investors.
